description:
V00.75 Eclipse-Store-backed implementations of the four
    persistence SPIs in jSentinel-events (EventStore, DeadLetterStore,
    ReplayStore, SequenceStore) plus the optional Eclipse Serializer
    PayloadCodec. Shares the V00.74.20 JSentinelStoragePair lifecycle:
    consumers feed pair.app() into this module's stores so the
    Security-Event-Bus persistence rides the framework's two-phase
    shutdown.
